caption: 「您這支推薦影片的真實度九十四%，要投多少？」
scene: An old man in his 40s with messy slightly curly hair, round glasses and a navy blue hoodie sits hunched in a dim apartment, staring at a glowing screen showing a smiling face identical to his own, rain streaking the barred window behind him, cold blue light, tense close-up composition.

caption: 「我就這樣坐在這裡，一句話都沒說過。」
scene: Extreme close-up of the old man's trembling hands gripping a cup of cold tea, his reflection ghosting across the monitor, a small translucent glowing cyan hologram girl floating beside him waving her arms frantically, cluttered desk, oppressive shadows.

caption: 「我什麼都沒擋下來。十萬支，只澄清七十幾支。」
scene: Wide night shot of a rain-soaked city, a towering bamboo-jointed skyscraper lit floor by floor, the old man silhouetted at the window with the glowing hologram girl beside him, distant neon reflections on wet streets, melancholy lighting.

caption: 「我是……再也不知道要相信什麼了。」
scene: Flashback panel, an elderly Taiwanese grandmother with curly grey hair and a floral apron holding an old phone in a dim kitchen, her face calm but hollow, a pot of braised pork steaming behind her, warm fading light, heartbreaking stillness.

caption: 「如果可以重來，先修那個『為什麼大家會相信』的 bug。」
scene: The old man smiling weakly, leaning back in his chair, the glowing hologram girl crying translucent tears that fall through the floor, rain drops outside beginning to float upward as thin streaks of light, surreal glowing atmosphere.

caption: 「這個不是正常的物理現象耶！」
scene: Dynamic panel of the city at night reversing, raindrops rising like streams of data into the sky, the bamboo skyscraper's lights shutting off from top to bottom, the old man and the glowing hologram girl staring in awe, swirling white light engulfing the room.

caption: 「這次要記得吃滷肉飯，你每次都忘記。」
scene: A vision of a steaming braised pork rice stall with a rehung signboard, the elderly grandmother in a faded apron turning to smile at a skinny student, golden warm light, soft focus, nostalgic and tearful mood.

caption: 「叮。」
scene: Pitch black panel with a single tiny glowing cyan dot in the center, faint silhouette of round glasses and a ladybug pin emerging from white light, mysterious and suspenseful, minimal composition, dramatic backlight.
